ASPIRE.notes: ASPIRE (MTN-020, dapivirine ring) is one of the 2 dapivirine trials pooled in this Cochrane review ('dapivirine (2 trials, 4588 women)'). PMC full text is not available as structured plain text (empty full_text field); extraction is abstract-only (confidence_layer_m: medium). The abstract states 'All 12 trials were conducted in sub-Saharan Africa' but does not name ASPIRE specifically or link it to African countries by name. Layer (a): no explicit African-cohort count claim for ASPIRE by name. Layer (b): no characteristics table accessible; cannot confirm country-level data per trial. Layer (c): abstract does not co-locate the ASPIRE trial name with an African country in the same sentence. All booleans FALSE pending full-text verification via Cochrane Library.
